name: inspire-time
title_zh: 捕捉可迁移洞见并绑定可观察实践的记录器
tagline_zh: 聊天中冒出改变判断或行为的念头，别让它溜走。它帮你把洞见钉在具体做法上，附上证据，不记普通摘录和情绪。
tagline_en: When a chat shifts your judgment or behavior, don't let it fade. This pins the insight to a concrete action with.
desc_en: Capture a transferable insight and connect it to a concrete real-world practice with observable evidence. Use when a conversation produces a reusable change in judgment or behavior. Do not capture ordinary excerpts, every learning note, transient emotion, or personality speculation.
why_zh: 它过滤掉摘录、情绪和性格猜测，只留真正改变你判断或行为的可复用洞见，并强制连接现实实践与证据。
why_en: It filters out excerpts, emotions, and personality reads, keeping only reusable insights that change how you think or act—then.
limit_zh: 只处理对话中产生的可迁移洞见；不保存普通摘录、学习笔记、瞬时情绪或人物猜测。需要你主动提供实践场景与证据。
limit_en: Only handles transferable insights from conversation; ignores excerpts, learning notes, transient moods, or personality speculation. Needs your.
title_en: Capture transferable insights tied to observable practice
